rules: Required layers are fixed by the canonical matrix in report/phase1/tests/test_editorial_register.py (Hindi language: 1, 3, 7, 8-18, C1-C4, C6; Jyotish: 1-7, C5; owner copy: 13, 15). A required layer is PENDING, ACCEPTED, REVISED or REJECTED, never NOT_APPLICABLE; every other layer is NOT_APPLICABLE.

A human or owner layer may leave PENDING only with a real, named human reviewer, their qualification and independence, an ISO decision date, the exact commit and catalog SHA-256 values reviewed, and evidence {path, sha256, commit} of a signed sheet under docs/i18n/review/kun-i18n-003/signed/ whose git blob at that commit (in the history of HEAD), at HEAD, in the index and in the working tree is identical; untracked, staged-only, modified, deleted, replaced or symlinked files fail, and without git a decided record fails closed.
AI assistants (Claude, ChatGPT or any other) never fill a human or owner layer or the release. Developer corrections and AI QA are recorded only in their own layers.
A decision is valid only for the catalog bytes it names; any later catalog change makes it stale until the reviewer re-confirms.
customer_release is PENDING or APPROVED. APPROVED requires every required layer of every item ACCEPTED (REVISED and REJECTED are never approvals) and a signed, attributed owner release record.

Exact git identity, not SHA format: every decision's reviewed_commit equals reviewed_source.commit; reviewed_source commit, tree and catalog blob IDs are checked against the git object database (blob IDs alone in a git archive, where any decided register is refused as unverifiable); an approved release names an explicit release_candidate {commit, tree, catalog hashes and blobs} that exists in git, contains the reviewed source and carries the reviewed catalogs, and customer_release.commit equals it.
